authority: research-wiki/operations/elgs-m0-m1-implementation-plan.md section 7.1 category 1; values fixed before implementation, never tuned on data

interval.note: floor_len = 2w + delta_len; floor_gap = 2w + delta_gap (spec section 1); frame-interval units convert to model time units via the dataset's inferred inter-frame dt

canonical_coordinate_order: slack_pre-iff-unlatched, len_1, gap_1, ..., gap_{K-1}, len_K, slack_post-iff-unlatched

family_seeding.rule: voxel-grid clustering of the initial cloud at seed_iteration; each nonempty voxel cell is one family with a K=1 spanning program, latch pattern (1,1), dim(a)=1
family_seeding.note: spanning-then-carve default route (lgs-method); family granularity at init is an implementation choice disclosed here — clone/split descendants inherit the family id thereafter

smoke.note: compressed for the non-evidence-bearing S1/S2 Apollo smoke only (elgs_smoke_schedule: true)

acceptance.note: spec section 7: B=200 paired cluster bootstrap; <=5 clusters => reject; SNIS weights <= 1/lambda_u with provably inactive clipping

merge_survivor: older parent by birth time, ties by lower family id (rev-3 A3)
camera_tie_break: ascending camera id (spec section 4 cap operator)
cluster_canonical_point: lowest-id seed of the connected component (rev-3 A2)
interior_truncate_delete: admissible per header v8.2 item (4), untagged normative revision text; adjudication recorded in the M0 wiki record
